confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors use current Japan-wide cost-of-living averages because no Matsuyama aggregate was found; local Matsuyama drink menus provide a check. Accommodation is a broad model estimate and can vary with season and Dōgo-area demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treat Matsuyama as a mid-sized regional Japanese city: use Japan-wide meal and coffee prices with a modest regional-city adjustment, and local menu examples for drinks. Lodging is estimated for a regional center with visitor demand.
